title: Adoption velocity & risk heatmap (working sheet)
content:
Purpose:
This working sheet is an operational scoring and playbook mapping for renewal risk and adoption velocity across enterprise customers. Designed to be compact enough for a QBR slide and detailed enough for operational triage.

High-level model summary:
- Composite Health Score (0-100) composed of normalized signals from: Adoption Velocity (30%), Feature Depth (20%), Performance (20%), Reliability (15%), Support Impact (10%), Billing Stability (5%).
- Risk Tiers: Healthy (>=80), Watch (60-79), At-risk (<60), Critical (<40).
- Flags are boolean/threshold triggers used for immediate escalation. Flags roll into playbook steps.

Signal definitions and normalization (implementation notes):
1) Adoption Velocity (weight 0.30) - shape: change in "active endpoints" or "active API keys" trending over trailing 30/60/90 days.
   - Raw: percent change QoQ or vs trailing 90d baseline. Cap improvements/drops at +/-100%.
   - Normalize: normalized_adoption = clamp((raw_pct_change + 100)/200, 0, 1) // maps -100% -> 0, 0% -> 0.5, +100% ->1
   - Primary role: leading indicator for renewals and upsell.

2) Feature Depth Score (weight 0.20) - how many advanced features of Redwood are in use: streaming, function-calling, prefix-caching, reranking, private endpoints.
   - Raw: count of "key features" in active use (0..6).
   - Normalize: normalized_depth = count / 6.

3) Performance (weight 0.20) - P95 latency in production and unit cost/throughput.
   - Raw: p95 latency (ms); convert to score = 1 - min(p95_ms / 2000, 1). (2000ms is hard cap).
   - If cost per token is > benchmark by 2x (for given model class) reduce score by 0.1 (floor 0).

4) Reliability (weight 0.15) - error rate and availability.
   - Raw: weekly error rate (5xx or client-visible errors). Score = 1 - min(error_rate/0.1, 1). (10% error ->0).
   - Availability adjustments: if availability < 99.9% subtract 0.2 from normalized (floor 0).

5) Support Impact (weight 0.10) - severity-weighted tickets and open regressions on evals.
   - Raw: 3*#sev1 + 1.5*#sev2 + 1*#sev3 over trailing 30d normalized by seat tier. Map to 0..1 with tier caps.

6) Billing Stability (weight 0.05) - unexpected spikes or usage anomaly detection.
   - Raw: percent delta vs forecast; >+30% flags anomaly. Score = 1 - min(max(delta_pct,0)/100,1). Negative deltas (less usage) reduce adoption but not treated as billing anomaly.

Composite calculation (illustrative):
- composite = round(100 * (0.30*norm_adoption + 0.20*norm_depth + 0.20*norm_performance + 0.15*norm_reliability + 0.10*norm_support + 0.05*norm_billing))
- Apply smoothing: use EWMA of composite over 14 days (alpha=0.2) for tiering decisions to avoid churn from single-day blips.

Risk flags (immediate triggers):
- Flag: Adoption drop >25% vs 90-day baseline -> "adoption-drop"
- Flag: New sev1 incident in last 14d -> "sev1-recent"
- Flag: P95 latency > 1500ms for last 24h or >1000ms sustained for 7d -> "latency-degraded"
- Flag: Error rate >2% for last 7d -> "error-rate-high"
- Flag: Billing delta +30% over forecast for 7d -> "billing-spike"
- Flag: Model-eval regression: recent eval failure on critical prompt set -> "eval-regression"

Operational playbook (mapping from tier + flags -> actions):
- Healthy (>=80): automated monthly check-in email, push QBR summary template. No immediate outreach unless eval-regression or billing-spike flag.
- Watch (60-79): CS owner 1-week check-in (email -> scheduled call if adoption flat). Run "Growth Pack" (feature enablement lab + in-app tips). If adoption-drop flag present, schedule 30-min product usage review within 7 days.
- At-risk (<60): CS owner + Solutions Eng kickoff within 48 hours. Create JIRA CS-Retention ticket. Priorities: diagnose adoption blockers (integration logs), run performance baseline (SRE + infra), map missed SLOs. Consider limited promotional credits contingent on remediation checkpoints.
- Critical (<40) or any sev1-recent: Executive alert, Renewal at-risk playbook engaged (legal/finance looped), 1-2 week war-room cadence, dedicated SRE/infra + SE pairing, immediate rollback/fallback to compatible model variant if degradation due to model swap.

Escalation matrix (RACI):
- CS Owner: Account owner, primary comms, renewal ownership.
- Solutions Eng: Feature depth dives, integration health.
- SRE/Infra: Performance and reliability remediation.
- Product: prioritize quick fixes or short-term toggles.
- Finance: billing anomalies and promotional credit approvals.

Sample rows (for slide/table copy):
| Customer | MA endpoints | Avg P95 (ms) | Err Rate % (7d) | FeatureDepth (0-6) | Adoption vel (30d %chg) | Billing delta % | Support Sev1/30d | Composite | Tier | Flags | Next step |
| -------- | ------------:| ------------:| ---------------:| -------------------:| ---------------------:| ---------------:| ----------------:| --------:| ----:| ----- | --------- |
| NovaPay  | 42 | 420 | 0.3 | 5 | +12% | +5% | 0 | 86 | Healthy |  | Monthly QBR email; note upsell opportunity |
| ClearDocs | 8 | 1180 | 2.8 | 2 | -34% | -2% | 1 | 44 | Critical | adoption-drop; error-rate-high; latency-degraded | Exec alert; SE+SRE war-room; offer free SE consulting; open CS-Retention jira |
| AtlasRetail | 16 | 760 | 0.9 | 3 | -8% | +38% | 0 | 58 | At-risk | billing-spike | CS owner call + billing review; Solutions Eng integration audit |

Notes on examples: numbers are illustrative. Composite rounded for readability. "Support Sev1/30d" uses count where any >0 increases urgency.

Implementation checklist (engineering ask / data fields):
- Required signals from telemetry: active_endpoint_count (daily), p95_latency_ms (daily/rolling), error_rate (5xx + client-visible errors aggregated daily), feature_usage flags per account (boolean for key capabilities), billing_forecast and actual usage by SKU, support ticket severity metadata, eval regression results per prompt set.
- ETL transforms: create rolling windows 7/30/90d, compute percent change and EWMA for smoothing.
- Expose API / dashboard fields: composite_score, tier, flags[], last_calc_time, driver_signal_breakdown (list in UI).

Open questions / tradeoffs (notes-to-self):
- Weighting sensitivity: adoption is primary for PLG upsell but for enterprise renewals reliability might deserve higher relative weight. Consider configurable templates per customer tier.
- Billing spikes: sometimes spikes are healthy (intentional scale). Need manual override workflow for flagged anomalies.
- FeatureDepth counts: need canonical list and instrumentation; some integrations are not tracked in telemetry yet.
- Windowing: 30d vs 90d baseline matters a lot for seasonal customers. Document default and allow account-level overrides.

Next steps (owner: Maya):
- 1) Align with SRE and infra on latency & error signal definitions (due 2026-02-20).
- 2) Create prototype dashboard in Looker with sample cohort (NovaPay, ClearDocs, AtlasRetail) (due 2026-03-05).
- 3) Run retrospective on last 6 renewals to validate thresholds (owner: Jordan) (due 2026-03-15).

References and quick links:
- CS playbook draft: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/CS/Retention+Playbooks
- Instrumentation PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/telemetry/pull/312
